task_definition.task_description: Please check Alice’s availability starting on 2025-07-01 for 2 slots, then look up the status of flight CA1234 and, if it’s on time, book an economy ticket on that flight for John Doe. After that, book a standard room at the Grand Hyatt for John Doe from 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-05, and then save a backup named backup_2025_06 for /workspace/project_a and send Alice an in-app medium-priority trip summary alert.
